tagline: 潘泰康胶片单反相机，1989 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1989年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度metal lamellae focal plane shutter with speeds 4, 2, 1, ½, ¼, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60 (mechanical, flash sync.), 1/125, 1/250,1/500, 1/1000 sec. plus B mode, self-timer。使用35mm with speeds ISO 12 to ISO 3200, frame size 24x36mm。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm with speeds ISO 12 to ISO 3200, frame size 24x36mm
specs.快门: metal lamellae focal plane shutter with speeds 4, 2, 1, ½, ¼, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60 (mechanical, flash sync.), 1/125, 1/250,1/500, 1/1000 sec. plus B mode, self-timer
specs.取景器: Pentaprism with matching-LEDs speed scale on right side of viewfinder and aperture value mirrored from lens tube into the bottom frame, and green "flash ready" LED fed by system flash
specs.英文简介:
*Type: SLR
*Manufactured by: Pentacon, Dresden (GDR, former East Germany)
*Year: 1989-1990
*Film: 35mm with speeds ISO 12 to ISO 3200, frame size 24x36mm
*Lens mount: Praktica bayonet
*Shutter: metal lamellae focal plane shutter with speeds 4, 2, 1, ½, ¼, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60 (mechanical, flash sync.), 1/125, 1/250,1/500, 1/1000 sec.
